entities.title: What init writes into a project
entities.summary: init merges zazzle's stdio server, when the daemon is installed, into .mcp.json, and a PreToolUse hook, zazzle's permission and enabled server into .claude/settings.json, removes the indexer's own server, permission and enabled server left by an earlier init, and keeps every other key.
consumers: Claude Code, the coding agent's harness, which reads the project's .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json
entities.definition: .mcp.json: mcpServers.csharp-indexer is removed (the indexer lists no tools), and, when zazzle's daemon is found beside the running csharp-indexer (both live in libexec/zazzle; PATH is not searched), mcpServers.zazzle = {type: "stdio", command: <upgrade-proof path of the daemon, a Homebrew keg path mapped to its opt link>, args: ["mcp"]}. .claude/settings.json: hooks.PreToolUse gets {matcher: "Bash|Grep|Glob|Read", hooks: [{type: "command", command: "<path> hook"}]} after any earlier entry whose command contains csharp-indexer and ends in " hook" is removed; permissions.allow loses "mcp__zazzle-csharp-indexer" and contains "mcp__zazzle" when daemon was found; enabledMcpjsonServers loses "csharp-indexer" and contains "zazzle" when daemon was found. Files are written as indented JSON with a final newline, creating .claude/ if needed. Without daemon, init writes everything else and its first output line says to install zazzle and run init again.
guarantees: Running init twice leaves no csharp-indexer server, one zazzle server, one csharp-indexer hook entry and no duplicate permission or enabled server.
Unrelated keys and entries in both files are kept.
A zazzle server entry written by an earlier init stays when the daemon is no longer found; init only adds or replaces it.
entities.compatibility: The keys follow Claude Code's project settings format; the commands are the absolute paths of the binary that ran init and of the daemon it found. The mcp__zazzle permission and the zazzle server name are what daemon's MCP tool names (zazzle_read, zazzle_find ...) are allowed under.

entities.title: What uninit removes from a project
entities.summary: uninit removes from .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json only the entries init writes, recognised by their shape, and leaves every other byte of both files as it was.
consumers: Claude Code, which reads the project's .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json
The developer, who may have edited both files by hand
entities.definition: Removed: mcpServers.zazzle when it is exactly {type: "stdio", command: <a path ending in daemon>, args: ["mcp"]} (with any other key it is kept and a line says so); in hooks.PreToolUse, each hook whose command ends in " hook" and contains csharp-indexer, taking its entry with it when the entry holds nothing else; "mcp__zazzle" from permissions.allow; "zazzle" from enabledMcpjsonServers. An object or array a removal leaves empty is removed too, innermost first. A file left holding nothing but empty objects and arrays is deleted, and .claude/ with it when that leaves it empty. Each item is cut out of the text with its separating comma and the whitespace that belonged to it; a UTF-8 byte-order mark is kept. Output: one line per change ("removed X from FILE", "deleted FILE: nothing else is left in it", "deleted the empty folder DIR"), "would ..." with --dry-run, or "nothing to undo in DIR".
guarantees: Bytes outside the removed items are unchanged; a file with nothing to remove is not written.
Running it twice is safe: the second run finds nothing to undo.
A file that is not JSON (comments, trailing commas, duplicate keys) is left unchanged with a line saying so.
entities.compatibility: Matches what init writes today. The indexer's own csharp-indexer server, permission and enabled server that an earlier init removed are not put back.

entities.title: The hook command
entities.summary: csharp-indexer hook reads one Claude Code PreToolUse event as JSON on standard input and answers with its exit code: 0 lets the tool call run, 2 blocks it with a message on standard error.
consumers: Claude Code's PreToolUse hook, configured by init
entities.definition: Input fields read: tool_name, tool_input.command (Bash), tool_input.file_path (Read) and session_id. Exit 0 and no output to allow; exit 2 and a message on standard error to block. The message names the zazzle tool to use instead, as an MCP tool and as a zazzle command: zazzle_find for searches (with zazzle_find_symbol for C# declarations and zazzle_refs for uses), zazzle_ls for listings, zazzle_read for reads, saying that C# files come as a terse view and that source=true gives the code and the sha edits need. For Bash, Grep and Glob it adds the # allow-raw escape.
guarantees: Grep and Glob calls are always blocked; Bash commands are blocked when a pipeline segment runs a searcher (grep, egrep, fgrep, rg, ag, ack, zgrep, git grep), find without an action that modifies or executes, a file reader (cat, head, tail, less, more, bat, nl) on a file without redirection (tail -f excepted), or sed -n without -i on a file.
A Read call is blocked when its file_path ends in .cs, in any letter case, and allowed otherwise; a blocked Read has no escape but ZAZZLE_INDEXER_HOOK=off.
A command containing # allow-raw is allowed and logged as allowed_raw.
Every blocked or raw-allowed call is written to the usage log as tool hook with reason blocked:<program> or allowed_raw:<program>.
